newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq backs off record as tech investors fret.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq backs off record as tech investors fret.

text.p: Worries about the upcoming third quarter earnings season gave technology investors the jitters, erasing an early rally in tech stocks and pulling the Nasdaq lower after yesterday's record close.
The Nasdaq Composite lost almost 11 points, or 0.86 percent, to 1240 at its unofficial close. Decliners led advancers by 23 to 18 on volume of about 580 million shares.
The index had hit a new all-time high on Monday for the first time in four months. This morning's early rally was quashed by investor worries, analysts said.
Bellwether blue-chip tech stock Intel Corp lost 3-1/8 to 101-5/8 despite hitting an earlier year-high and Microsoft fell 2-1/8 to 135-3/8.
Cisco, which had alo been as high as 66-7/8, eased back to 66-1/2, up 1/2.
